releases.name: Ultra Rad's Slide Hustle
releases.summary: A puzzle game where you manage a limited budget as you navigate your way through garage sales and thrift stores to purchase valuable items. Research, repair, and resell those items for profit until your dad is proud of you.

releases.name: Waaaaaa: A Prehistoric Adventure With Aliens
Zone//Zero
releases.summary: Zone//Zero is a futuristic single player first person shooter. Your objective is to survive various enemies, find keys, modify your weapons, and expand your arsenal with high tech gadgets. With changing levels and boss battles hidden in the space maze, challenge yourself to be the best runner.

releases.name: Ward 9
releases.summary: Start your engines for the latest motorcycle racing app! Drift your way to the finish line as you dodge cars and motorcycles! The further you drive the harder it gets! Throughout the race you will be able to pick up ITEMS that will help you along the race; you'll get hooked and won't want to stop playing! Compete against yourself and the world, since this app comes with game center. Are you up for the challenge? Amazing graphics and equipped for both iPhone and iPad! What are you waiting for? Start your engine! Bonus, if you crash against some "powers" you will have special power, see instructions inside game for details. Be Like Paul Walker or Vin Diesel in Too Fast and the Furious. Deck out Ride!!

releases.name: Thread the Wall
releases.summary: Which Adam Lambert song caused a controversy at the 2009 American Music Awards? What was the first Beatles’ song to enter the US charts? Which song features the lyric, “Let the bass from the speakers run through ya sneakers”? No matter the genre of music that you love, you'll have a blast playing this game that features more than 500 questions, ranging from easy to difficult, on top billboard hits from the 1960s to today. Every trivia answer is the name of a famous song! Learn interesting facts about the musicians, lyrics, and history of pop, classic, rock, hip-hop, and electronic music. Challenge a friend to play, save your score, and post your records on Facebook!

releases.name: TrailRush
releases.summary: Race against the clock, earn trophies and climb the leaderboards in this 2D platformer designed for speedrunning!

releases.name: Vivi
releases.summary: Vivi is a desktop companion girl longing to be human. Unobtrusive company, auto-dances to PC sounds, supports feeding. Raise intimacy & obedience for 9 relationship states. Full voice acting, collect human traits and share photos on Steam Workshop.

releases.name: Stella Supernova: The Astral Vale
releases.summary: Jump, dash, dodge, and fight countless stellar bosses in a 2D action-platformer playable solo or with up to 8 players locally, featuring unlockable powers, upgrades, cinematic QTEs, and an emotional story.

releases.name: Still Sorting
releases.summary: Get ready for the race of your life! Speedboat 3D will take you on a cRaZy fast thrill ride! Race down the open water against other speedboats while trying to avoid countless obstacles coming your way! Do you have what it takes to win the race?!FEATURES- Super easy controls! - Realistic graphics!- Hand crafted speedboat designs.- Custom soundtrack.- Game center support!

releases.name: Shuffle and Seek
releases.summary: Shuffle and Seek is a 2-4 player party game of memory and mischief! Take turns playing as the Shuffler, who secretly rearranges the room, and the Seeker, who must spot exactly what changed. Move big items for big points, but don't get caught!

releases.name: Vinyl Freak: Unsorted
releases.summary: THE NEXT GENERATION OF BASHING GAMES IS HERE!Bash anybody you want!Innovative, grotesque, superfun. That's Bash Your Friends!Game Features:- choosable locations for a bloody gameplay- choose anybody you want from your photo album, or facebook account to play with- choose the standard figure if you are only in the mood of a random smashing experience- share your custom-made postcard with your friends on Facebook and Twitter- activate Megahammer for mass destruction- beat friends' scores in Game CenterCAUTION: SENSE OF HUMOR REQUIRED

releases.name: Sun Ge Doesn't Believe in Tears
releases.summary: The best Tic Tac Toe game is here. So killing the boredom is now in your finger tips. Come out of the cross and Noughts(xoxoxo) and get ready to Play the classic Tic tac Toe in a mysterious environment. The free game will sure thrill you with its visual style, sound and what more, challenge your intelligence at the same time.Game ModesYou can play the game against the specially designed AI (single Player) or against your friend / valentine (two players).Gem SelectionThe game allows you to select your favourite stone to play the game. You have four different option to choose from.Player NamesThe game by default assigns you one of the mysterious alias name to play the game. You may also choose to play the game with your name.Game PlayYou dont' need to beat the beast or run in temples. Just sit and play the game. With its unique style, the game promises to entertain enthral and kill your boredom.This game provides pudding to your brain and is a monster time killer.

releases.name: Stick It to the Stickman
releases.summary: Stick it to the Stickman is a physics-based brawler where you fight heaps of red stickmen to become the boss. Choose from hundreds of unique moves to construct the perfect combat machine and fight your way to the top of the corporate ladder.

releases.name: Bibi & Tina - Ready, Set, Ride!
releases.summary: A summer full of friendship, tournament excitement and horse-filled happiness: Ride with Bibi, Tina and Alex as they compete for the cup, stand together against unfair rivals – and dive into varied horse-riding adventures, with action-packed carriage races among the special highlights.

releases.name: Gassed Up!
releases.summary: A top-down 3D workplace party game. Play solo or online with up to 10 players: finish tasks, manage your rising fart meter, use outrageous employee skills, accuse coworkers, and clock out first.

releases.name: HemoSim
releases.summary: Sling Shooter Fun Game-Fun game, with different kind of birds and levels.-Shoot birds, which are flying in random speed.-The more fast bird you hit, the more score you will gain!!! So be fast..-Shoot balloons which contains +500 bonus points.-Do not hit Helicopters, as it will reduce the score by 100.-The game contains 10 minutes of time limit and 10 levels.-Each level contains different kind of birds and backgrounds.-You can also choose different kinds of slings as you wish.So Enjoy!!!!
